How much does a 3-minute AI video cost?

How do we calculate this?

Every dollar figure on this page comes from the price rows when the site is built. API rows use the vendor's stated dollars per second. Credit-plan rows use plan price ÷ credits × credits per clip ÷ seconds, and assumes every credit you pay for is used. A promo shows its end date. An approximate row is one the vendor marked with "~", "roughly", or "estimated". The full method is on the about page (https://sheepinboots.github.io/clipcost/about/).
